convention.direction: ox = IP (eV), red = -EA (eV); both are maximised
convention.note: a consequence, not a sign bug: P1_red - P0_red is the negative of the underlying EA correction, because the P0 layer stores +eps_LUMO

x2_policy: X2 columns are mechanism-only.  The model runner asserts they never enter a feature set, so no table can claim to predict a C1 quantity cheaply by using a C1-derived descriptor.

settings.oof_metric_scope: all candidates in the task's usable set
